entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF88-2190.
Okay, VF88-2190. Let me pull that up for you. I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Grip cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Yes, the shoes. I just need to know if I can return them.
I can certainly check that for you. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They're uncomfortable. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I got terrible blisters on my last ride. I'm done with them.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me check the return eligibility right now. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that the delivery date was 58 days ago. Our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Good. So what's the next step? Are you sending a label?

Yes, I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. And I do see that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble with the blisters, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.
Oh. A credit. Okay, that's good. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed immediately. Was there anything else I could assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
